messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-98321 — embeddings-service (eu-west) high 5xx rate (>250/min). auto-escalation to oncall.
pagerbot: page: PD-98321 -> @kevin (primary oncall). link: https://pd.example/r/PD-98321 :rotating_light:
kevin: acked. on it. starting quick triage. ETA 5m.
kevin: seeing a sharp increase in embedder retries and 502s from the gpu-infer pool in eu-west-1.
mitesh: @kevin can you confirm if this is affecting hosted customers or just dedicated pools?
kevin: quick check — traffic map shows both hosted API and a couple Dedicated tenants in eu-west. impact: approx 12% request error rate for embeddings for the last 7m.
sara: I'm heading to customer comms. listing affected customers now, will DM product team.
kevin: grabbing logs, running: ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embedder-eu --since=10m | grep -i "timeout\|502" | head -n 50``` getting frequent Redis timeouts and a spike in connection refused from redis-proxy.
lisa: ops-shift-lead flagged that we just rolled a redis-proxy config change 9m ago in eu-west. could be related.
ops-shift-lead: confirm: redis-proxy rollout <config/redis-proxy:e5c1> completed 9:03 UTC.
mitesh: ok passing to me to lead mitigation. @kevin handoff in 1 message. kevin, any active debugging steps you want me to continue?
kevin: handing off — I reproduced errors, collected heap/profile and tail of redis logs (attached in thread). I'm going to scale down embedder replicas to stop pile-up and let backlog drain. Mitigate first.
mitesh: ack. scaling embedder-eu deployment to 0.5x then back to 1.5x to force reconnection pattern and avoid connection storms. running: `kubectl scale deploy/embedder-eu --replicas=4` then monitor.
mitesh: also going to rollback redis-proxy to previous config if we still see failures after scale. calling the rollback now.
incidentbot: action: rollback started for redis-proxy to tag e5b7 (previous). estimated finish ~2m.
kevin: copied. continuing logs: redis-proxy metrics show surge in client connections then OOMs on 1 instance.
sara: drafted initial customer ping: "We're investigating an embeddings degradation in eu-west; teams are actively mitigating. We'll update in 15m or sooner." tagging affected accounts.
mitesh: rollback finished. restarting embedder pods now.
mitesh: post-rollback quick check: redis-proxy connection count back to baseline, error rate on embedder down from 12% -> 3% in last 90s.
kevin: running synthetic check against a few tenants — responses ok for 10/12 samples, two fail with transient 502s (retry handled at client).
lisa: verifying infra alarms — alert suppressed for 5m to avoid page loop while we stabilize.
ops-shift-lead: noted. adding timeline to incident doc: PD-98321, start 3777880000, rollback at 3777880280, partial recovery at 3777880350.
sara: customer update sent. cc: support & product.
mitesh: I'll stay on to monitor for another 20m then hand back to oncall rotation. anyone wants to join watch?
kevin: good handoff. I'll ping if anything unusual. thanks all.
pagerbot: PD-98321 state -> acknowledged by mitesh. escalation ended.
incidentbot: incidentbot note: root cause suspected config regression in redis-proxy rollout; follow-up: postmortem + RCA owner = eng-infra, assignee mitesh. ETA draft 48h.
kevin: adding notes to incident doc and linking logs. closing oncall handoff in 20m.
mitesh: final status ping: error rate steady <2%, redis nodes stable, will open RCA doc now.
sara: thanks team :thumbsup:
kevin: :heart:
